newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly softer. [CORRECTED 10:33 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly softer. [CORRECTED 10:33 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline from "...ends steady in moderate trade")
The Taiwan dollar finished a touch softer (corrects from firmer) against the U.S. dollar on Tuesday on improved volume.
At the close, the Taiwan dollar was quoted at T$27.495 per U.S. dollar, compared with Monday's T$27.487 finish. Daily turnover rose to US$196.5 million from US$117 million.
"The morning was kind of busy," said a dealer.
Two-way flows from importers and exporters picked up early on, slowed in the afternoon and had another bout of activity near the close, he said.
But prices hardly budged, the dealer noted.
Dealers said they expected light trade on Wednesday as the market winds down before the October 10th National holiday.
